title: AICTE Security Deposit Portal - 6-Minute Guided Tour
description: Step-by-step walkthrough of seven key security and compliance capabilities for regulatory evaluation.

steps.title: Institution: coverage card -> calculator -> submit FDR
steps.goal: Check mandatory security deposit requirements, calculate required amount, and submit a new fixed deposit record.
do: Sign in as the Institution persona using the 1-click switcher.
Review the Coverage Card showing required versus confirmed deposits.
Open the calculator to compute required funds based on selected programmes.
Submit a new FDR with reference number, bank code, and 10-year maturity date.
steps.expect: A new instrument record appears with the Claimed badge, pending bank verification.
steps.why: Institutions can see exact required deposits computed directly from handbook rules without manual guesswork.

steps.title: RO requests bank confirmation -> SIMULATED reply -> gate report
steps.goal: Request authoritative bank verification for a submitted deposit and inspect the cryptographic validation report.
do: Switch to the Regional Officer persona.
Open the case page for the submitted instrument.
Click the single primary action button 'Request Bank Confirmation'.
View the full cryptographic verification gate report.
steps.expect: The enforced checks pass; simulated revocation is shown as not checked and the status badge turns green to Confirmed (SIMULATED).
steps.why: No deposit is trusted on institution claims alone. Bank verification confirms validity cryptographically.

steps.title: Break the gate: forged letter / appended page / replayed token
steps.goal: Test system defenses by attempting three common fraud attacks against the bank verification gate.
do: In the Break-Me Workbench on the case page, select 'Forged Letter Attack'.
Test an 'Appended Bytes' attack where trailing pages were added.
Test a 'Replayed Token' attack using an already consumed verification challenge.
steps.expect: Every attack is immediately rejected with clear explanations and zero false passes.
steps.why: Standard PDF signers often miss appended pages. The portal enforces byte-prefix and boundary checks.

steps.title: Amount mismatch -> flag with plain message -> waiver demands a reason
steps.goal: Detect an amount discrepancy between bank and institution claims and enforce accountability before waiver.
do: Run an amount mismatch test where the bank confirms less than claimed.
Notice the plain-language warning explaining the shortfall.
Try waiving the flag with a blank reason to confirm validation blocks it.
Enter a detailed reason of at least 10 characters to record the waiver.
steps.expect: The waiver is accepted only with a written justification and permanently logged to audit.
steps.why: Officers cannot silently bypass discrepancies without creating an immutable paper trail.

steps.title: Bureau advances the clock through rule offsets -> worker -> reminders
steps.goal: Fast-forward the virtual clock to test automated background reminders and escalation notices.
do: Switch to the Bureau Approver persona.
Open the Time Machine dropdown in the header and advance +30 days.
Advance to +60 days to trigger escalation notices.
Advance to +90 days to verify overdue alerts and review emails in Mailpit.
steps.expect: Dashboard categories automatically update and reminder emails appear without manual tracking.
steps.why: Automates tracking for 10-year deposits so renewals and maturities are never forgotten.

steps.title: Renewal: replacement FDR -> chain and coverage-gap check
steps.goal: Submit a replacement FDR linked to an expiring instrument and verify custody continuity.
do: Switch back to Institution persona.
Submit a renewal FDR referencing the original instrument ID.
Open the case page to review the linked predecessor.
Check that coverage continuity is maintained without unmonitored gaps.
steps.expect: The old instrument links to the new one in a complete verifiable renewal chain.
steps.why: Prevents institutions from letting deposits lapse during renewal transitions.

steps.title: Release: institution requests -> RO verifies -> same RO approve blocked -> bureau approves -> receipt -> offline verify
steps.goal: Perform dual-custody authorized deposit release and verify cryptographic encashment receipt.
do: As Institution, request term completion release.
As Regional Officer, verify the request (maker step).
Confirm that Regional Officer cannot approve (role check blocks it).
As Bureau Approver (checker), approve release and view cryptographic receipt.
steps.expect: Status becomes Released, receipt token is generated, and audit chain passes verification.
steps.why: No single officer can authorize the release of security deposits. Dual-custody stops insider fraud.
